milestones.title: D1 — Institutional & Data Source Mapping
milestones.objective: Build the first systematic institutional evidence base for Évora and expand the civic data-source catalogue without searching for software ideas.

workUnits.title: WU-D1-01 — Research Repository Infrastructure
workUnits.objective: Establish the repository-level structured research record workflow: storage layout, schemas, lightweight validator, synthetic fixtures, and the research handoff protocol. No substantive Évora research.
outOfScope: Do not perform substantive research about Évora
Do not create real SRC-*/EVD-*/PRB-*/HYP-* records
Do not select a civic product or authorize Évora Open API implementation
acceptanceCriteria: node tools/validate-research.js exits 0 against research/ (no canonical records yet)
node tools/validate-research.js --dir research/examples exits 0 against fixtures

workUnits.title: WU-D1-02 — Mobility, Territory, Urban Infrastructure & Accessibility
workUnits.objective: Integrate reviewed research handoffs covering Mobility & Transport, Geography & Territory, Urban Infrastructure, and Accessibility into structured records.
scope: Integrate reviewed SRC-*/EVD-*/PRB-* handoffs for MOB, GEO, URB, ACC
outOfScope: Do not perform the underlying research locally
Do not select a civic product
acceptanceCriteria: All integrated records pass node tools/validate-research.js

workUnits.title: WU-D1-03 — Housing, Social Support, Health & Wellbeing
workUnits.objective: Integrate reviewed research handoffs covering Housing, Social Support, and Health & Wellbeing into structured records, with particular care for privacy on health data.
scope: Integrate reviewed SRC-*/EVD-*/PRB-* handoffs for HOU, SOC, HEA
outOfScope: Do not perform the underlying research locally
Do not retain unnecessary personal or health data
acceptanceCriteria: All integrated records pass node tools/validate-research.js

workUnits.title: WU-D1-04 — Economy, Employment, Talent & Education
workUnits.objective: Integrate reviewed research handoffs covering Economy & Business, Employment & Talent, and Education into structured records.
scope: Integrate reviewed SRC-*/EVD-*/PRB-* handoffs for ECO, EMP, EDU
outOfScope: Do not perform the underlying research locally
Do not infer private-sector pain solely from public-sector strategy documents
acceptanceCriteria: All integrated records pass node tools/validate-research.js

workUnits.title: WU-D1-05 — Culture, Tourism, Sports & Public Life
workUnits.objective: Integrate reviewed research handoffs covering Culture & Events, Tourism, and Sports & Leisure into structured records.
scope: Integrate reviewed SRC-*/EVD-*/PRB-* handoffs for CUL, TOU, SPO
outOfScope: Do not perform the underlying research locally
Do not assume an events API is needed
acceptanceCriteria: All integrated records pass node tools/validate-research.js

workUnits.title: WU-D1-06 — Environment, Climate, Public & Digital Services
workUnits.objective: Integrate reviewed research handoffs covering Environment & Waste, Climate & Energy, Public Services, and Digital Access & Services into structured records.
scope: Integrate reviewed SRC-*/EVD-*/PRB-* handoffs for ENV, CLI, PUB, DIG
outOfScope: Do not perform the underlying research locally
Do not propose replacement systems where a service already exists
acceptanceCriteria: All integrated records pass node tools/validate-research.js

workUnits.title: WU-D1-07 — Consolidation & D1 Closure
workUnits.objective: Consolidate D1 records, verify the D1 exit gate, and produce the D1 closure record without creating a solution backlog.
scope: Deduplicate problem clusters and verify evidence/source linkage
Review domain coverage and record contradictions/gaps
Evaluate the D1 exit gate and produce closure record
outOfScope: Do not select a civic product
Do not authorize Évora Open API implementation
acceptanceCriteria: D1 exit gate criteria evaluated in docs/milestones/D1-institutional-data-source-mapping.md
node tools/validate-research.js passes against the full canonical record set

checkpoints.summary: Established the D1 research repository infrastructure: storage layout, faithful schemas, zero-dependency validator, synthetic fixtures, and the recording/handoff protocols. No substantive Évora research was performed.
completed: Created research/{sources,evidence,problems,hypotheses,examples,schemas} layout with .gitkeep placeholders for empty canonical directories.
Created research/schemas/{source,evidence,problem,hypothesis}.schema.json faithful to docs/models/*.md, with one documented clarification (EVD source.source_id).

Created tools/validate-research.js, a zero-dependency Node validator (custom minimal YAML parser; duplicate-ID, malformed-YAML, missing-field, invalid-enum, prefix-mismatch, and broken-reference checks).
Created synthetic fixtures under research/examples/{sources,evidence,problems,hypotheses}, clearly marked as non-canonical.
